headline: Nvidia Halts Server Shipments to Four Southeast Asian Countries, Reports Financial Times
summary: Nvidia instructed manufacturing partners to halt server shipments destined for four Southeast Asian nations, according to media reports citing industry sources.
why: Export and supply chain restrictions in key regional markets can alter revenue distribution and disrupt regional tech manufacturing ecosystems.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Halting server shipments to specific regional markets can interrupt product delivery schedules and revenue flows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Sudden restrictions on server hardware shipments to regional markets create concerns over logistical bottlenecks and hardware distribution channels.
